reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output shape; the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs, so no unnecessary edits were introduced.

Cited text supports the conclusion: §14 permits Client termination on written notice with services running only to the end of the following month, imposing no early-termination fee or minimum-term buyout, and §8(f) reserves only TrueLink's general legal/equitable rights rather than any fixed or per-message penalty payable by Client.

The rationale correctly characterizes §5(a) minimum monthly fees and the pay-pending-dispute mechanic as ordinary fee-commitment terms rather than Customer-payable liquidated damages, and appropriately notes the unfilled blanks as an observation rather than flagging a deviation.
No deterministic check failures; finding is properly retained as internal evidence rather than raised as a negotiation issue.
